description.zh-CN: 一条记录代表一个时间条件；同一客户公海的生效条件由池策略中的 AND/OR 关系组合。
description.en: Each record is one time condition. Active conditions for the same pool are composed by the pool's AND/OR match mode.

helpText.zh-CN: 使用稳定且唯一的业务编号，便于审计和排查。
helpText.en: Use a stable unique business code for audit and troubleshooting.

placeholder.zh-CN: 例如 30 天未跟进自动回收
placeholder.en: e.g. Recycle after 30 days without activity

helpText.zh-CN: 名称应直接说明触发条件和业务结果。
helpText.en: Name the condition by its trigger and business outcome.

placeholder.zh-CN: 选择应用该条件的客户公海
placeholder.en: Select the customer pool for this condition

helpText.zh-CN: 同一公海的生效条件按池策略中的 AND/OR 关系组合。
helpText.en: Active conditions in the same pool are composed by its AND/OR policy.

helpText.zh-CN: 数字越小越先评估；相同结果不依赖顺序。
helpText.en: Lower values evaluate first; equivalent outcomes must not depend on order.

description.zh-CN: 相对天数运算填写“相对天数”；固定区间填写开始/结束时间；固定早于使用结束时间，固定晚于使用开始时间。
description.en: Relative operators use Relative Days. Fixed intervals use both endpoints; Fixed Before uses the end and Fixed After uses the start.

placeholder.zh-CN: 说明适用客群、例外和运营约定
placeholder.en: Describe segments, exceptions, and operating conventions

helpText.zh-CN: 说明不参与机器判断；实际回收只以结构化条件为准。
helpText.en: Descriptions are not evaluated; recycle uses only structured condition fields.
